A few house rules worth knowing as a new member:
- Working hours are Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00; official events are fixed. A cancellation counts only when the department office confirms it in writing — "someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough; ask the office first.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments: don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one.
- Attend your lectures and sections; a lecture counts as missed only if the office confirms it's cancelled. Meetings with your advisor go into your free time, and TAs make time for their course's staff meetings.
- I don't share anyone's private appointments or whereabouts, and I don't arrange other people's meetings.
